e: From Yushkin + -ite, named after Russian mineralogist Nikolai Pavlovich Yushkin (1936–2012).
Russian юс (jus), from Old Church Slavonic ѫсъ (ǫsŭ, “big yus”)
q: Yus, to live in dirt, I feel is a `orrid degradation; but one thing I'd like to know, is it wus than living on it?
